positions.name: AsyncRememberContractRatification
positions.frame: Is this expression performing the async remember contract's mechanics and guarantees as an already-settled decision — ratified fact spoken in the pipeline's own vocabulary — rather than as a proposal still under discussion?
positions.why: All three expressions read as settling rather than arguing: the conviction dimension marks each as 'decision' — src-1 performs the ratification act itself, src-2 states the contract's negative guarantees as invariants the ratified contract enforces, and src-3 labels its own restatement 'Key decision' and lays out the dispatch/poll/piggyback mechanics as settled procedure. The register dimension reinforces this: all three share the same native pipeline-contract vocabulary ('receipt', 'polling a cursor', 'dispatches', 'piggybacked') identified as one register mint spanning the set. Held in tension: src-1/src-2 are animated by Wynn Castellano in one footing case (fc-1) while src-3 is animated by Xena ExpertGH in a distinct footing case (fc-2) and shifts temporal orientation from past/present to future-procedural — a different speaker reaffirming rather than originating the ratified contract, not contradicting it.
